stories.title: Ecatepec rehabilita pozo Colosio 1 para aumentar abasto de agua; beneficiará a 30 mil habitantes

en.title: Ecatepec rehabilitates Colosio 1 well to increase water supply; will benefit 30,000 residents
en.summary: The Colosio 1 well in Ecatepec has been restored to service after approximately eight years of closure, with officials stating it will improve water distribution to 30,000 inhabitants in the area.

stories.title: Mara Lezama anuncia 100 autobuses híbridos para Cancún; habrá 4 nuevas rutas de transporte público

en.title: Mara Lezama announces 100 hybrid buses for Cancún; there will be 4 new public transport routes
en.summary: Cancún is introducing 100 hybrid buses and four new public transport routes expected to serve approximately 322,821 residents with an estimated daily ridership of 80,188 passengers.

stories.title: AMLO acusa a Marco Rubio de revocar visa de Andy López Beltrán; califica medida de "canallesca"

en.title: AMLO accuses Marco Rubio of revoking Andy López Beltrán's visa; characterizes measure as "despicable"
en.summary: Mexico's president accused Marco Rubio of revoking a visa for Andy López Beltrán and criticized the action using strong language.

stories.title: Trump firma orden ejecutiva sobre el diésel rojo; autoriza a estadounidenses comprar combustible libre de impuestos

en.title: Trump signs executive order on red diesel; authorizes Americans to purchase tax-free fuel
en.summary: An executive order permits temporary use of tax-free diesel fuel on roadways under White House measures.

stories.title: Separatistas ganan elecciones en Quebec; prometieron referéndum independentista

en.title: Separatists win elections in Quebec; promised independence referendum
en.summary: A separatist party has won elections in Quebec and has committed to holding an independence referendum. The party's return to power presents a challenge for Prime Minister Mark Carney.

stories.title: Mara Lezama cambia la historia del transporte en Cancún: MOBI lo lleva a la altura de un destino turístico mundial

en.title: Mara Lezama changes the history of transportation in Cancun: MOBI brings it to the level of a world tourist destination
en.summary: MOBI is expanding its fleet in Cancun from 38 to 138 units and plans to reach six routes by December 2026, elevating the city's transportation infrastructure.

stories.title: Trump permite la compra de diésel "rojo" libre de impuestos a todos los compradores

en.title: Trump allows purchase of untaxed red diesel for all buyers
en.summary: The U.S. government has authorized the sale of tax-free red diesel to all purchasers. The decision was made in response to rising fuel prices linked to tensions with Iran affecting the Republican Party before midterm elections.

stories.title: Investiga FGE posible atentado contra Gobernador de Nayarit

en.title: State attorney's office investigates possible attack on Governor of Nayarit
en.summary: Authorities in Nayarit are investigating whether a small aircraft crash may have been an attack targeting the state governor, who faces criminal threats.

stories.title: Avioneta usada por gobernador de Nayarit se desploma en Ixtlán del Río; Fiscalía no descarta posible atentado contra Miguel Navarro

en.title: Small plane used by Nayarit governor crashes in Ixtlán del Río; prosecutors do not rule out possible attack against Miguel Navarro
en.summary: A small aircraft used by the governor of Nayarit state crashed in Ixtlán del Río. State prosecutors are investigating whether the crash was an intentional attack, after finding information about official flights on seized mobile phones.

stories.title: Firma orden Trump para reducir costos de diesel

en.title: Trump signs order to reduce diesel costs
en.summary: Trump signed an executive order to relax restrictions on the use of a tax-exempt diesel variety aimed at lowering fuel costs.

stories.title: Independentistas de Quebec lideran encuestas en elecciones, con la promesa de referéndum

en.title: Quebec independentists lead polls in elections, with promise of referendum
en.summary: Independentist parties are leading election polls in Quebec ahead of voting for the 127 seats of the provincial National Assembly, promising to hold a referendum.

stories.title: Acto 'canallesco' quitar visa a 'Andy', dice AMLO

en.title: AMLO calls visa cancellation of 'Andy' a 'despicable' act
en.summary: Mexico's president condemned the cancellation of his son's visa as despicable and accused the United States of making the decision without justification to benefit right-wing interests.

stories.title: ¿Qué empresas serán las más afectadas por la jornada de 40 horas y por qué tendrán que cambiar?

en.title: Which companies will be most affected by the 40-hour workday and why will they have to change?
en.summary: Seven out of ten companies report they are unprepared for the labor hour reduction. Experts explain how technology and demand planning can help prevent cost increases.

stories.title: Plan México incentiva a la farmacéutica Adium a expandir capacidad industrial e investigación local

en.title: Plan México encourages pharmaceutical company Adium to expand industrial capacity and local research
en.summary: Adium plans to increase its involvement in clinical research through licensing agreements and strengthen local production of solid pharmaceuticals.

stories.title: Nafin quiere apoyar a más MiPymes y coloca 9,750 mdp como parte del Plan México

en.title: Nafin wants to support more SMEs and places 9,750 million pesos as part of Plan México
en.summary: Nafin completed its third certificate placement in the national market in 2026, supported by the strength of its financial indicators.

stories.title: Falta de sanciones en su diseño amenaza la efectividad de la Ley de Economía Digital

en.title: Lack of sanctions in its design threatens the effectiveness of the Digital Economy Law
en.summary: Experts note that the upcoming Digital Economy Law will improve product traceability and help reduce crimes like fuel theft, though they highlight concerns about the absence of penalty provisions.

stories.title: TikTok te paga hasta 70,000 pesos al mes por tus videos, pero nada tiene que ver si se hacen virales

en.title: TikTok pays you up to 70,000 pesos per month for your videos, but it has nothing to do with whether they go viral
en.summary: TikTok's monetization program called "Special Reward Program" has been operating for approximately three months and rewards content quality rather than viral success.
